prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1219; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while the insured vehicle was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means.

Please provide the complete declarations page for the policy covering the insured vehicle, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits in effect on the date of loss, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also request written confirmation of the identity of the assigned claims adjuster.

Your insured is under a duty to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes dash camera or telematics data, photographs, vehicle event data recorder information, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim file notes, and any communications with the other driver or witnesses. We ask that you instruct your insured in writing to preserve these materials and that you do the same within your own claim file.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
